test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In March 2025, under which of the following schemes did the government identify 100 coastal fishermen villages to be developed into Climate‑Resilient Coastal Fishermen Villages?
solution: The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)** was launched by the Government of India in **2020** under the Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry, and Dairying. • The scheme aims to bring about a **Blue Revolution** through sustainable and responsible development of the fisheries sector in India. • In **March 2025**, the government identified **100 coastal fishermen villages** to be developed into **climate-resilient villages** under the PMMSY initiative. • The focus of the scheme is to enhance the **socio-economic conditions of fisherfolk**, improve their livelihood opportunities, and ensure their resilience to climate change. • The scheme includes **modernization of fishing infrastructure**, promotion of sustainable fishing practices, and development of cold chains and markets for fisheries.
